About Astrowani

Online astrology consultations, reading tools and articles to help you explore your questions.

Connect with an astrologer in a way that suits you

Astrowani brings astrologer profiles, one-to-one consultation options and astrology resources together. You can explore specialities such as kundli reading, marriage matching, career astrology, numerology and tarot, then choose an astrologer whose language and approach fit your question.

Consultation options include chat, voice and video, depending on the astrologer's services and current availability. Browse astrologer profiles or go to consultations to compare the available options.

Know what you are choosing

Review the profile, language, speciality and displayed rate before beginning. Check whether the astrologer is available for your preferred mode. Prices and availability can vary; use the current information shown when you book rather than assuming every session has the same cost.

If an introductory offer appears on your account, read its eligibility and limits. For paid sessions, review the rate and wallet balance, and keep your session or payment reference if you need help later.

Explore before booking

Our blog offers articles on astrology topics. You can explore free services, horoscopes and Panchang, or read about a specific service before deciding whether a personal consultation would be useful.

Guidance with room for your own judgement

Astrology is a traditional interpretive practice. A consultation should help you ask questions and consider perspectives, not guarantee an outcome or make decisions for you. No reader should pressure you through fear into buying a remedy or continuing a session. Read our safety guidelines for using the platform.

Support and policies

For account, session or payment questions, contact support@astrowani.com. Include the relevant reference and a description of the issue, without sharing passwords or payment PINs.

See our terms and conditions, privacy policy and refund and cancellation policy for the details that apply to using Astrowani.

Where can I compare astrologers?

Open the astrologer directory to explore profiles, then check the current mode, rate and availability before starting a consultation.

Where can I ask about learning astrology?

Visit our course enquiry page for what to ask about learning options. Enrollment dates, fees and instructor details need confirmation from the team.
